          Every active SKILL.md is injected into the agent file each iteration,

          Occurrence counts are kept by the daemon, not by the model: repeated-pattern
          counting is the thing an LLM is least reliable at.

Proposals awaiting review

Obsidian vault

        

          The vault is a git repo and an Obsidian folder at once. This window can configure the
          folder, but only you can tell Obsidian about it — there is no supported way for a
          program to add a vault, and obsidian.json belongs to a running app.
        

        

        

          
          
          
          
        


        
Credentials

        

          Stored in the macOS Keychain and loaded into the daemon's environment. Values travel
          one way: there is no endpoint that reads a key back, so nothing here — including this
          window — can show you a key you have already saved. Replace it if you lose it.
        

        

        

          Prefer never to have a key in a window at all?
          wikiskilld credential set <service> prompts in the terminal, with
          the value going straight from your keyboard to the Keychain.
